title: Oechsler on the news: Inman convinced him vehicles are non-human

tellings.quote:
Well, Admiral Inman convinced me
that uh these vehicles were uh not
manufactured by human technology. So
that's pretty conclusive for me.

plain: A man named Bob Oechsler said in a news clip, sometime between 1989 and 1999, that a retired admiral named Bobby Ray Inman had convinced him that certain craft "were not manufactured by human technology". Oechsler is passing on what he says he came to believe through Inman, and he calls it "pretty conclusive" for him. If true, it would mean a senior military figure privately backed the idea that non-human vehicles exist.
